summary: perf(shared): skip the blob rewrite when a prune removes nothing
description:
Because:
- Session creation prunes an id that is never cached, so most prunes
  read the whole blob and wrote it back unchanged.
- A throw from startSpan would have left pruning disabled for good.

This commit:
- Releases the WATCH and returns when no requested id is in the blob.
- Counts those prunes as redis.pruneSessionTokens.noop.
- Starts the span before setting the busy flag.

Closes FXA-14945
